reference_method: Manual transcription from rendered PDF regions; v6 corrects two scan crops that clipped printed text at the horizontal edges; the Vietnamese balance-sheet rows were visually checked at full resolution.
limitations: Six manually reviewed regions: five carried from v4 (Vietnamese financial infographic, English sustainability text, Vietnamese raster-embedded product artwork, and two image-only English governance scans with corrected full-width text crops) plus one Vietnamese two-period financial table rendered from a born-digital PDF page. The new table adds manually reviewed row/value references but is not a physical scan. This pilot remains too small for model selection and has only one table page.
